title: Conformance corpus under JBMC and --engine auto: no Verified the JVM refutes
description: Step 1d of llm-dlc/loops/sound-verdicts.md. lib/tests/conformance.rs holds 54 small Java methods (lib/tests/conformance/conformance/Conformance.java) with 93 claims, 48 of which a real JVM refutes. The cases cover the gaps and their reproducers (a negative capacity to ArrayList, HashMap, HashSet and StringBuilder; synchronized (null); Random.nextBytes), field hiding, literal identity, class initializers that throw, exceptions (finally overriding a return, nested handlers, bounds, casts, throw null, rethrow), aliasing, null arrays, record constructors, virtual and default-method dispatch, and arithmetic edge cases (MIN_VALUE / -1, negative remainders, shift counts out of range, narrowing, overflow). A Java runner executes every call and every claim's generated harness on the JVM. The test run inline covers the tool's own checker under --gaps strict and assume. This job runs the ignored test, which puts every claim through --engine jbmc and --engine auto under --gaps strict. It fails if either engine says Verified for a claim the JVM refutes, or reports a violation whose witness does not refute the harness on the JVM.
expected: exits 0: the_corpus_agrees_with_the_jvm_under_jbmc_and_auto passes. The log lists each claim's verdict per engine. A failure lists each disagreement with the JVM, which is a finding about JBMC or the adapter to triage under the brief's Progress, not something to retry.

resources.notes: about 93 JBMC property runs on methods of a line or two, up to three interval stages each, plus the auto fallbacks on about 14 refused claims; the native half of the same test takes 11 s in the session

steps.name: conformance corpus under JBMC and auto
steps.run: set -o pipefail; cd lib && JVMCONTRACT_JBMC_MEMORY_MB=2048 cargo test --release --test conformance -- --ignored --nocapture 2>&1 | tee target/conformance-jbmc.log
